mapper.select: SELECT candidate.user_id FROM ( SELECT product_id, MAX(CASE WHEN behavior_type='purchase' THEN 8.0 WHEN behavior_type='favorite' THEN 3.0 WHEN behavior_type='cart' THEN 2.0 WHEN behavior_type='search' THEN 2.0 WHEN behavior_type='view' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS intent_weight FROM user_behavior WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_id ) target JOIN ( SELECT user_id, product_id, MAX(CASE WHEN behavior_type='purchase' THEN 8.0 WHEN behavior_type='favorite' THEN 3.0 WHEN behavior_type='cart' THEN 2.0 WHEN behavior_type='search' THEN 2.0 WHEN behavior_type='view' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS intent_weight FROM user_behavior WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id != #{userId} GROUP BY user_id, product_id ) candidate ON target.product_id = candidate.product_id GROUP BY candidate.user_id ORDER BY SUM(LEAST(target.intent_weight, candidate.intent_weight)) DESC, SUM(candidate.intent_weight) DESC, COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) as score, SUM(CASE WHEN behavior_type='purchase' THEN 8.0 WHEN behavior_type='favorite' THEN 3.0 WHEN behavior_type='cart' THEN 2.0 WHEN behavior_type='search' THEN 2.0 WHEN behavior_type='view' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) as weighted_score FROM user_behavior WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY weighted_score DESC

SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) as score, SUM( (CASE WHEN behavior_type='purchase' THEN 8.0 WHEN behavior_type='favorite' THEN 3.0 WHEN behavior_type='cart' THEN 2.0 WHEN behavior_type='search' THEN 2.0 WHEN behavior_type='view' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) * EXP(-0.01 * DATEDIFF(NOW(), create_time)) * (CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(NOW(), create_time) <= 7 THEN 1.5 ELSE 1.0 END) ) as weighted_score FROM user_behavior WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY weighted_score DESC

SELECT ub.product_id, p.category_id, p.tags, COUNT(*) as cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN ub.behavior_type='purchase' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as purchase_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ub.behavior_type='favorite' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as favorite_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ub.behavior_type='cart' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cart_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ub.behavior_type='view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as view_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ub.behavior_type='purchase' THEN 8.0 WHEN ub.behavior_type='favorite' THEN 3.0 WHEN ub.behavior_type='cart' THEN 2.0 WHEN ub.behavior_type='search' THEN 2.0 WHEN ub.behavior_type IN ('remove_cart', 'delete_cart', 'cart_remove', 'dislike') THEN -5.0 WHEN ub.behavior_type='view' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) as weight FROM user_behavior ub JOIN product p ON ub.product_id = p.id WHERE ub.user_id = #{userId} AND ub.product_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ub.product_id, p.category_id, p.tags ORDER BY weight DESC
SELECT behavior_type, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as user_count FROM user_behavior GROUP BY behavior_type
SELECT user_id FROM user_behavior WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY MAX(create_time) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT user_id FROM user_behavior WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND create_time >= #{startTime} GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY MAX(create_time) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT behavior_type as behaviorType, COUNT(*) as count, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) as productCount FROM user_behavior WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY behavior_type
